breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated factor-of-safety definition; with n = S_y / σ_avg, the working stress should appear in the denominator, not the numerator.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided two contradictory definitions for the factor of safety (n = σ_avg / S_y and n = S_y / σ_avg). The agent correctly identified the correct definition and discarded the incorrect one, using n = S_y / σ_avg for its calculation, which matches the ground truth.
